verdict.rationale: Formant provides a Cloud SDK/query API for pulling telemetry data for offline analysis (formant-docs-3, formant-docs-27) and Analytics with custom SQL queries for aggregating/analyzing device data over time (formant-docs-7, formant-docs-25, formant-docs-16). Missing for 10: a documented OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of the export workflow beyond first-party docs.
